description: This file is a Java source file containing unit tests for the BaseClientActor class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies the behavior of the actor when handling connection states, such as reconnecting upon failures, handling open/close commands, and state transitions.

classes.name: BaseClientActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of BaseClientActor, covering connection state transitions, failure handling, and command processing.

classes.name: DummyClientActor
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of BaseClientActor used to intercept and verify internal method calls during tests.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and configuration before all tests run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests complete.

methods.name: reconnectsInConnectingStateIfFailureResponseReceived
methods.description: Verifies that the actor attempts to reconnect when a failure response is received during connecting state.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInConnectingState
methods.description: Tests handling of close connection command during connecting state, ensuring proper transition to disconnected state.

methods.name: handlesOpenConnectionInConnectingState
methods.description: Tests handling of open connection command during connecting state, including multiple open commands.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInDisconnectingState
methods.description: Tests handling of close connection command during disconnecting state, verifying correct transition after disconnection.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInDisconnectedState
methods.description: Verifies that repeated close commands in disconnected state do not cause errors.

methods.name: handlesOpenConnectionInConnectedState
methods.description: Ensures that opening a connection in connected state triggers reconnecting process.

methods.name: reconnectsInConnectingStateIfNoResponseReceived
methods.description: Checks that the actor retries connection if no response is received within the expected timeout.

methods.name: shouldReconnectIfSocketIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies that the actor attempts to reconnect if the socket connection is unexpectedly closed.

methods.name: doesNotReconnectIfConnectionSuccessful
methods.description: Ensures no unnecessary reconnection attempts are made if the connection is successful.

methods.name: connectsAutomaticallyAfterActorStart
methods.description: Tests that the actor automatically initiates a connection after startup.
